title: Tracing Subliminal Learning Through Pretraining
abstract: arXiv:2610.30884v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models trained on data generated by other models can sometimes inherit traits unrelated to that data, a phenomenon called subliminal learning. We study both hard label distillation, where students train on numbers generated by a biased teacher, and on-policy soft label distillation, where students generate the data and the teacher's logits provide the learning signal. Using Pythia, PolyPythia, and DataDecide OLMo models, we find that transfer persists in both settings across differences in weight initialization, pretraining data order, pretraining corpus, model size, and architecture. Across pretraining checkpoints, the ability to transmit a preference and the ability to acquire one develop separately: some checkpoints are more effective teachers but weaker students, and vice versa. Consistent with this distinction, cross-model transfer can be strongly asymmetric in magnitude when teacher and student roles are reversed. To

translated_title: 追踪预训练过程中的潜意识学习
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型在由其他模型生成的数据上训练时，有时会继承与该数据无关的特征，这种现象被称为“潜意识学习”（subliminal learning）。我们研究了两种设置：硬标签蒸馏（学生在由有偏差的教师生成的数字上训练）和同策略软标签蒸馏（学生自己生成数据，教师的logits提供学习信号）。使用Pythia、PolyPythia和DataDecide OLMo模型，我们发现这种迁移在两种设置中均持续存在，且不受权重初始化、预训练数据顺序、预训练语料库、模型规模和架构差异的影响。在预训练的各个检查点上，传递偏好的能力和获得偏好的能力是分开发展的：某些检查点作为教师更有效但作为学生较弱，反之亦然。与这一区别相一致，当教师和学生的角色互换时，跨模型迁移在程度上可能表现出强烈的不对称性。
tldr: 该研究证明“潜意识学习”现象在硬标签蒸馏和同策略软标签蒸馏中均普遍存在，且不受权重初始化、数据顺序、语料库、模型规模和架构的影响，并首次发现传递偏好与获得偏好的能力在预训练过程中独立发展，导致教师与学生角色互换时迁移强度呈现强烈不对称。
en_tdlr: This study demonstrates that subliminal learning persists in both hard-label and on-policy soft-label distillation regardless of weight initialization, data order, corpus, model size, or architecture, and reveals that the abilities to transmit and acquire preferences develop separately across pretraining checkpoints, yielding strongly asymmetric cross-model transfer when teacher and student roles are reversed.
